candidates.exact_span: e. Results of a groundwater monitoring program developed by a qualified ground-water scientist, or a certification by a qualified groundwater scientist may be used to demonstrate that sewage sludge placed on an active sewage sludge unit does not contaminate an aquifer.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether groundwater monitoring results or a scientist certification satisfies the obligation, and what evidence type counts as adequate for periods without numeric monitoring data, depends on how the disjunctive requirement is interpreted and which pathway applies.

candidates.exact_span: a. Report No for no liner and leachate collection system at surface disposal site.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of when a surface disposal site lacks a liner and leachate collection system determines whether this reporting item is required and whether a no-report/no-data state reflects non-applicability versus missing evidence.

candidates.exact_span: b. The frequency of monitoring listed in Element II, Section I.D. which applies to the permittee.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Element II, Section I.D. monitoring frequency applies to the permittee governs whether monitoring was required for each evaluated period.

candidates.exact_span: c. Toxicity Characteristic Leaching Procedure (TCLP) results (Pass/Fail).
candidates.computation_change_reason: Pass/Fail TCLP reporting may be treated as a non-numeric compliance criterion, a report-only result, or a limit comparison depending on interpretation, affecting limit applicability, monitoring obligation scope, and how absent or non-numeric results are classified.

candidates.exact_span: d. The concentration (mg/K g) in the sludge of each pollutant listed in Table 5 as well as the applicable pollutant concentration criteria listed in Table 5.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This ties reported sludge pollutant concentrations to Table 5 criteria; interpretation of which Table 5 pollutants and criteria apply determines the enforceable numeric limits and the monitoring results subject to comparison.

candidates.exact_span: e. The concentration (mg/Kg) of PCB's in the sludge.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether PCB concentration reporting carries an enforceable numeric limit or is report-only monitoring depends on how this requirement is read against external limit tables, changing both applicable limits and monitoring obligations.

candidates.exact_span: g. Level of pathogen reduction achieved (C lass A or Class B), unless Vector attraction reduction alternative no. 11 is utilized.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The exception for Vector attraction reduction alternative no. 11 makes pathogen-reduction reporting conditionally required; different readings of when that alternative is utilized change whether monitoring was required and how missing pathogen data should be classified.

candidates.exact_span: h. List Alternative used as listed in Section I.C.3.(a. or b.). Alternatives describe how the pathogen reduction requirements are met.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which Section I.C.3 alternative is selected can change downstream conditional monitoring and reporting obligations and whether missing numeric results reflect a documented alternative pathway.

candidates.exact_span: i. Vector attraction reduction Alternative used as listed in Section I.C.4.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The chosen Section I.C.4 vector-attraction alternative, including alternative no. 11 referenced elsewhere, affects whether related monitoring and reporting items are required and how no-data periods are interpreted.

candidates.exact_span: m. A narrative description explaining how the management practices in §503.24 are met shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This establishes a narrative rather than numeric evidence type for management-practice compliance, affecting how missing ordinary numeric results are classified when only narrative documentation is expected.

candidates.exact_span: n. The certification statement listed in 503.27(a)(1)(ii) or 503.27(a)(2)(ii) as applicable to the permittees sludge disposal activities, shall be attached to the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Which 503.27 certification variant applies, and whether attached certification satisfies the monitoring evidence expectation, changes obligation applicability and the documented state for periods without numeric measurements.
